**Ekkokardiografi** (echocardiography) is a diagnostic examination required for newly diagnosed patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] within a specific timeframe, forming the basis for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] in the Danish healthcare quality monitoring system [^src1] [^src4]. The procedure is critical for assessing patients, and Indikator 2 measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who undergo echocardiography from 6 months before to 3 months after their initial diagnosis date [^src2] [^src3]. The national standard for this quality indicator is set at ≥ 80% [^src1]. According to recent national data, 81.0% of patients were examined with echocardiography within this specified timeframe, successfully meeting the standard [^src8].

Data regarding echocardiography is sourced from both the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) and the National Health Service Register (Sygesikringsregisteret) [^src8]. However, validation work has revealed a significant degree of missing service reporting to the National Patient Register, particularly from departments operating under the Sundhedsplatformen health IT system [^src8].

In terms of medical coding, echocardiography is identified by a variety of codes across different registers. In the National Patient Register, it is coded under [[uxuc80|UXUC80]] (transthoracic echocardiography) and its variants, including [[uxuc80a|UXUC80A]], [[uxuc80b|UXUC80B]], [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]], [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], and [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]], as well as transesophageal codes like [[uxuc81|UXUC81]] and [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] [^src4] [^src9] [^src10]. In the National Health Service Register, it is tracked using codes such as [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src4].
